name: Tower AC units
description: Free-standing cooling solutions suitable for compact spaces where a wall or ceiling unit is not preferred.
long_description: Tower ACs stand on the floor and push a strong, long-throw air stream. That makes them useful where walls are glazed, ceilings are high, or a quick setup is needed without false-ceiling work. They pair with an outdoor unit like a split AC and are often used in shops, waiting areas and halls that need fast pull-down cooling.
features: Powerful long-throw airflow for quick cooling
No wall or ceiling mounting needed
Simple installation and easy to relocate
Good for glass-fronted shops and high-ceiling rooms
